premises.text: College recruiting is becoming increasingly competitive as companies seek to hire talented students.
premises.evidence_span: college recruiting at large is getting increasingly competitive

premises.text: Hiring new graduates is a cost-effective strategy for companies.
premises.evidence_span: young and talented students bring a lot of energy and hard work to a company and they cost a lot less

premises.text: Building relationships with students is key to successful college recruiting.
premises.evidence_span: just like in traditional recruiting relationships are the key to hiring great students

premises.text: Traditional recruiting services do not work well for college recruiting due to students' lack of connections.
premises.evidence_span: you can't rely on networking and referrals because students usually are not well connected

premises.text: Companies can use a platform to manage relationships with students over multiple years.
premises.evidence_span: maritful is a platform as a service for college recruiting teams to build and manage their relationship with students over multiple years

premises.text: Companies can create challenges for students to identify great candidates.
premises.evidence_span: companies can create challenges for students to work on this can be programming design business challenges

premises.text: Meritful helps companies build sustainable relationships with students tied to recruiting efforts.
premises.evidence_span: meritful is built for companies that want to build the best thing possible and have a long-term vision for their college recruiting efforts

value.text: Companies can effectively hire talented students through relationship building.
value.evidence_span: if you want to hire the best students you need to build a relationship with them

notes: Feedback from companies and beta launch details are excluded as traction.
